app.name: Scrum Manager
app.tagline: From idea to delivery, with Scrum discipline.

spaces.emptyBody: Start by creating a space for your team.
spaces.emptyBodyNoCreate: Spaces you are added to will appear here.

roleHelp.OWNER: Manages everything; can delete the workspace.
roleHelp.MEMBER: Creates spaces and works in the spaces they belong to.
roleHelp.GUEST: Sees only shared spaces and can comment.

login.title: Sign in to Scrum Manager
login.subtitle: Continue to your workspace.
login.noAccount: No account? Ask a workspace admin for an invitation; you'll create your account from the link in the invitation email.

setup.title: Set up Scrum Manager
setup.subtitle: Create the first workspace and its Owner account. This screen appears only once.
setup.tokenHint: Printed to the server logs when the API first starts.

forgot.title: Forgot your password?
forgot.subtitle: Enter your account email and we'll send you a reset link.
forgot.sentBody: If {{email}} is registered, a reset link will arrive in a few minutes. The link is valid for 60 minutes.

reset.title: Set a new password
reset.subtitle: Changing your password signs you out on every device.
reset.doneBody: You can now sign in with your new password.
reset.missingToken: The link is incomplete. Open the link from the email again.

invite.title: Join the {{workspace}} workspace
invite.emailHint: The address the invitation was sent to; it can't be changed.
invite.expires: This invitation is valid until {{date}} and can be used once.
invite.existingAccount: An account already exists for {{email}}. Sign in with it to accept the invitation.
invite.wrongAccount: You're signed in as {{current}}. Sign in as {{email}} to accept this invitation.
invite.invalidBody: The link may have been used, revoked or expired. Ask a workspace admin for a new invitation.

home.subtitle: What is waiting for you today?
home.assignedEmpty: No open work is assigned to you.
home.favoritesEmpty: Spaces, folders and lists you favorite appear here.

members.title: Members
members.subtitle: Manage who can access the workspace and their roles.
members.removeConfirm: Remove {{name}} from the workspace? They will lose all access.
members.guestSpacesHint: Guests only see the selected Spaces and can comment there.
members.guestSpacesRequired: Choose at least one Space for a guest invitation.

profile.title: Profile
profile.subtitle: How other members see you.
profile.passwordChanged: Password changed; sessions on other devices were signed out.

preferences.title: Preferences
preferences.subtitle: Language, theme and time zone apply on all your devices.

sessions.title: Sessions
sessions.subtitle: Devices where your account is signed in. End any session you don't recognize.

design.title: Design system
design.subtitle: The same visual language is used everywhere in the app (brief §11).
design.sampleTitle: As a user, I want to reset my password

errors.UNAUTHENTICATED: Your session has expired, please sign in again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You don't have permission to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: The record you're looking for was not found.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many attempts. Try again in a minute.
errors.NETWORK: Can't reach the server. Check your connection.
errors.CSRF_INVALID: Security check failed. Reload the page and try again.
errors.TOKEN_INVALID: The link is invalid or has expired.
errors.ALREADY_MEMBER: This person is already a workspace member.
errors.INVITE_REQUIRES_LOGIN: Sign in to accept the invitation.
errors.INVITE_EMAIL_MISMATCH: This invitation was sent to a different email address.
errors.LAST_OWNER: The workspace must keep at least one Owner.
errors.OWNER_ONLY: Only an Owner can do this.
errors.WORK_ITEM_PARENT_REQUIRED: A sub-task must have a parent item.
errors.WORK_ITEM_PARENT_NOT_ALLOWED: This item can't be placed under the selected parent.
errors.SPACE_KEY_TAKEN: This key has been used before; choose another.
errors.GUEST_STAKEHOLDER_ONLY: Guests can only be added to a Space as Stakeholder.
errors.GUEST_SPACES_REQUIRED: Choose at least one Space for a guest invitation.
errors.CONTAINER_ARCHIVED: You cannot add to an archived item.
errors.WORK_ITEM_PARENT_SPACE: The parent must be in the same Space.
errors.WORK_ITEM_ESTIMATE_NOT_ALLOWED: Story Points apply to Epics, Stories and Bugs; hour estimates to Tasks and Sub-tasks.
errors.WORK_ITEM_ESTIMATE_INVALID: The estimate does not match this Space's scale.
errors.WORK_ITEM_FIELD_NOT_ALLOWED: This field is not available for this work item type.
errors.WORK_ITEM_TYPE_NOT_ALLOWED: This type is not available in a simple-list Space.
errors.LABEL_NAME_TAKEN: A label with this name already exists.
errors.WORK_ITEM_BLOCKED: This item is blocked by an unfinished item.
errors.WORK_ITEM_LINK_SELF: An item cannot be linked to itself.
errors.WORK_ITEM_SPLIT_NOT_ALLOWED: Only a Story can be split into Tasks.
errors.CHECKLIST_LIMIT: An item can have at most 20 checklists.
errors.ATTACHMENT_TOO_LARGE: The file exceeds the allowed size.
errors.ATTACHMENT_TYPE_BLOCKED: This file type is not allowed for security reasons.
errors.ATTACHMENT_INVALID: The file is invalid or its content does not match its extension.
errors.ATTACHMENT_LIMIT: An item can have at most 50 attachments.
errors.AVATAR_INVALID: The photo must be PNG, JPEG or WebP and at most 2 MB.
errors.SCRUM_DISABLED: Scrum is turned off in this Space; sprints and the Backlog are unavailable.
errors.SPRINT_READONLY: A completed or cancelled sprint cannot be changed.
errors.SPRINT_NOT_PLANNED: Only planned sprints can be deleted.
errors.SPRINT_DATES_LOCKED: The dates of an active sprint cannot be changed.
errors.SPRINT_ITEM_NOT_ELIGIBLE: Only top-level Stories, Bugs and Tasks can join a sprint; completed items cannot.
errors.SPRINT_ACTIVE_EXISTS: This Space already has an active sprint; complete it first.
errors.SPRINT_GOAL_REQUIRED: A sprint goal is required to start the sprint.
errors.SPRINT_NOT_ACTIVE: Only an active sprint can be completed.
errors.SPRINT_CANCEL_NOT_ALLOWED: A completed or cancelled sprint cannot be cancelled.
errors.SPRINT_NEXT_INVALID: The carry-over sprint must be planned and in the same Space.
errors.DOD_INCOMPLETE: The Definition of Done is incomplete.
errors.DOD_ENFORCED: The Definition of Done is required in this Space; check every item before moving to Done.
errors.READINESS_NOT_APPLICABLE: Definition of Ready/Done only applies to Stories and Bugs.
errors.DOC_CONFLICT: This page was changed elsewhere. Your text was not overwritten; reload the page and continue.
errors.DOC_PARENT_INVALID: The page cannot be moved under this parent (cycle or too deep).
errors.DOC_DELETED: The page is in the trash; restore it first.
errors.RETRO_NOT_AVAILABLE: Retrospectives are only held for active and completed sprints.
errors.RETRO_NOT_ACTION: Only action items can be turned into tasks.
errors.RETRO_ALREADY_CONVERTED: This action already became a task.
errors.RETRO_NO_LIST: There is no List to create the task in.

spaceForm.name: Name
spaceForm.keyHint: Work item IDs start with this key: {{example}}
spaceForm.keyRules: 2–10 characters; starts with a letter, A–Z and 0–9 only.
spaceForm.descriptionPlaceholder: Which product or team works in this Space?
spaceForm.publicHelp: All workspace Members can view and comment; joining is required to do work.
spaceForm.privateHelp: Only Space members can see it.
spaceForm.modeScrumHelp: Sprints, Epics, Product Backlog and Scrum roles enabled.
spaceForm.modeSimpleHelp: Lists and tasks only; Scrum features off.
spaceForm.noOtherMembers: No other workspace members to add.
spaceForm.goalRequiredHelp: When on, a sprint without a goal cannot start; when off you only get a warning.

structure.name: Name
structure.deleteBody: It moves to the trash and can be restored within 30 days. Folders and lists inside are hidden too.
structure.archivedBanner: This item is archived and hidden from the sidebar.
structure.notFoundBody: This item may have been deleted, or you do not have access.

spacePage.notMember: You are not a member of this Space; you can view and comment.
spacePage.backlogBody: Set priorities, plan sprints and move items into them.

listPage.emptyTitle: No work items in this list yet
listPage.emptyBody: Creating Epics, Stories, Tasks, Sub-tasks and Bugs comes in the next step (1.3).

spaceSettings.title: Space settings
spaceSettings.readOnly: Only Product Owners, Scrum Masters and admins can change settings.
spaceSettings.keyChangeNote: Only new work items use the new key; existing IDs never change.
spaceSettings.membersHelp: Owners and Admins have full access to every Space; they need not be listed here.
spaceSettings.statusesHelp: Status names, colors and workflow become customizable in Phase 2.

generalSettings.title: General
generalSettings.subtitle: Workspace name and Space creation permission.
generalSettings.name: Workspace name
generalSettings.membersCanCreateSpacesHelp: When off, only Owners and Admins can create Spaces.

archive.title: Archive and trash
archive.subtitle: Restore archived and deleted Spaces, folders and lists.
archive.trashHint: Items in the trash are permanently deleted after {{days}} days.

items.title: Title
items.quickCreateChild: Add a sub-item… (Enter, Esc to close)
items.emptyTitle: No work items in this list yet
items.emptyBodyWrite: Type a title in the row below and press Enter.
items.emptyBodyRead: There is nothing to show here yet.
items.openChildrenBody_one: {{count}} sub-item is not done yet. Mark as done anyway?
items.openChildrenBody_other: {{count}} sub-items are not done yet. Mark as done anyway?
items.dodBody: {{count}} DoD items are not checked. Mark it Done anyway?

detail.acceptanceHint: Write Given-When-Then or a plain list.
detail.splitHelp: Each line becomes a Task (up to {{max}}). The Story stays unchanged.
detail.panelHelp: Work item details and editing fields.
detail.archivedBanner: This item is archived and cannot be edited.

editor.heading: Heading
editor.linkPrompt: Link address (https://… or mailto:…). Leave empty to remove.

view.filteredHint: You cannot add items while filters are on; clear them first.

myWork.title: My work
myWork.subtitle: Your work across all Spaces, by due date.

empty.assigned: No open work is assigned to you.
empty.created: You have no open work you created.
empty.watching: You are not watching any open work.

search.title: Search
search.help: Search task titles, descriptions or an ID (e.g. MOB-12).
search.hint: Type a task title, description or MOB-12.

comments.title: Comments
comments.placeholder: Write a comment… use @ to mention someone
comments.readOnly: You cannot comment in this Space.

attachments.title: Attachments
attachments.dropHint: Drop files here or click "Add file".

backlog.title: Backlog
backlog.empty: The Backlog is empty. Stories, Bugs and Tasks added to lists show up here in priority order.
backlog.reorderHint: Clear the filters to change the order.

sprints.name: Name
sprints.datesLocked: The dates of an active sprint cannot be changed.
sprints.capacityPlaceholder: E.g. 3 people, one out for 2 days
sprints.deleted: {{name}} deleted; its items went back to the Backlog.
sprints.deleteBody: The sprint is deleted and its items return to the Backlog.
sprints.empty: This sprint has no items yet. Move items over from the Backlog.

errors.END_BEFORE_START: The end cannot be before the start.
errors.TOO_LONG: A sprint can last at most 8 weeks.

sprints.goalRequired: A sprint goal is required in this Space. Edit the sprint and write one.
sprints.goalMissingWarn: No sprint goal has been entered.
sprints.emptyWarn: The sprint has no items yet.
sprints.allDone: All items are done. The sprint will be completed and its velocity recorded.
sprints.unfinishedQuestion: {{count}} items are not done. What should happen to them?
sprints.carryOver: Carry over to the next sprint
sprints.noNextSprint: There is no planned sprint to carry over to; create one first.

sprints.scopeChangeAdd: {{name}} is active; adding {{count}} items counts as a scope change and shows in reports.
sprints.scopeChangeRemove: {{name}} is active; removing {{count}} items counts as a scope change and shows in reports.
sprints.notReadyWarn: {{count}} items do not meet the Definition of Ready.

board.readOnlyCompleted: This sprint is completed; the board is read-only.
board.readOnlyCancelled: This sprint was cancelled; the board is read-only.

planning.noSprint: No sprint to plan. Create one on the Backlog page.
planning.backlogEmpty: The Backlog is empty; everything is in a sprint.

notifications.settingsSubtitle: Choose which events notify you and through which channel. Changes are saved immediately.

docs.title: Page title
